name: majesty-recruiting
description: Static recruiter site generated with Eleventy and served by Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev _site --port ${PAGES_PORT:-8788} --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings=0 eleventy.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.mjs scripts functions src tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .htmlvalidate.json eleventy.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs functions jsconfig.json package.json playwright.config.mjs scripts src tests wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run validate:data && npm run build && npm run validate:html && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:brand && npm run audit:secrets
